Advocate for the petitioner(s): Mr. S Banik Advocate for the respondent(s): Ms. P Barua for respondent Nos.2 to 4.
 Ms. U Das, Govt. Advocate, Assam  Mr. RS Mishra for respondent No.5
BEFORE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEVASHIS BARUAH
ORDER 29.07.2025 Heard Mr. S Banik, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Page No.# 5/6 petitioner.

Ms. U Das, the learned Additional Senior Govt. Advocate, Assam who appears on behalf of the respondent No.1, Ms. P Barua, the learned counsel, who appears on behalf of the respondent Nos. 2 to 4 and Mr. RS Mishra, the learned counsel who appears on behalf of the respondent No.5.
None appears on behalf of the respondent No.6 2.

Today, Ms. P Barua, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent Nos.2 to 4 has placed before this Court the Broad Sheet/ Technical Evaluation Committee Report as per clause 17.2 of the bid document, a copy of which has been furnished to Mr. S Banik, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.
3. While hearing the instant writ petitions, a question arose as to whether the respondent Nos.5 and 6 can be said to be technically eligible in terms with Clause 3.(v) of the bid document.

sentences.text: 4 4. This aspect arose in view of the fact that from a perusal of the Broad Sheet/Technical Evaluation Report, it appears that insofar as the respondent Nos.5 and 6 are concerned, the turnover of only 4(four) years was taken into account i.e. from 2017-18 to 2020-21.

5. Ms. Tina Mitra, the Member of the Technical Evaluation Committee, who was present during the course of the hearing, upon a query made to her by this Court, it was submitted that the respondent Nos.5 and 6 did not submit the financial report for the year 2021-22, however, they duly submitted the financial report for the last 5(five) years from 2016-17 to 2020-21.
She further submitted that the Technical Evaluation Committee taking into consideration that 2016-17 would not be taken into account, disregarded the turnover for that period.
However, it is seen that even taking 4(four) years i.e. from 2017 to 2020-21, the Page No.# 6/6 average of the respondent Nos.5 and 6 is more than 1(one) crore of the last 5(five) years.
6. It is seen from the affidavits so filed that this aspect is not reflected.

7. List these matters on 05.08.2025.
8.
An affidavit be brought on record on behalf of the respondent Nos.2 to 4 clarifying the said aspect of the matter as could be seen from the Broad Sheet/ Technical Evaluation Committee.
9. The affidavit be filed by 01.08.2025.
10. Interim order passed earlier shall continue till the next date fixed.
